faq.q: Which product photo should I upload?
faq.a: Choose a sharp photo of the item you plan to feature and keep the whole product inside the frame.

faq.q: When should I add the discount?
faq.a: Add the final price, code, and sale dates as text after those details are set.

faq.q: Can I use the same video on a store page?
faq.a: Use the same featured product in the video and the destination page so the offer feels connected.

overview.h2: Make the product the fixed point of the sale
overview.d: A Black Friday scene can be vivid without carrying every promotion detail. Choose one product, one visual hook, and one area for your offer; then reuse the visual while the confirmed price, date, or code is finalized.
Use your real stock note, end date, and offer language in the final edit. The generated clip supplies a moving backdrop for the sale rather than inventing inventory, countdowns, or savings.

input_guide.h2: Prepare a sale product with overlay room

items.d: A complete product silhouette gives the sale scene a reliable hero even when the background becomes dramatic.
Choose an angle with sky, wall, floor, or desk space where a discount badge will remain readable.

items.t: Keep the offer out of the photo
items.d: Use a clean image without temporary price stickers so the final promotion can be changed safely.
Say neon street, warm gift table, or focused studio light and keep the product action simple.

after_download.h2: Apply the promotion when it is final

items.d: Type the confirmed percentage, price, code, or bundle terms in your editor.
Place the real start and end dates, timezone, and stock wording on a layer you can update.
Add licensed music or a countdown effect only after the visual timing is approved.

visual.overview: A Black Friday ad opens with a product action or a creator showing the item. Add the confirmed offer, code, and end date after download so every detail stays accurate.

steps.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the exact product: a pale frosted cylindrical serum dropper bottle with a white cap and blank label. Preserve its shape, pale color, cap and label area. An adult creator holds the bottle beside her face and says, "This serum is featured in this week’s offer." She turns it once and finishes with the full bottle facing the lens. Warm vanity light, natural skin texture. Chest-up front-facing handheld framing. Sound: her voice and a cap click; no music.

cards.label: Talking-Head Offer: serum held to camera
cards.prompt: Photorealistic square Black Friday UGC ad still: an adult creator holds a plain serum bottle toward the camera in a warmly lit seasonal bathroom. Keep the full bottle and blank label sharp, chest-up framing. Freeze a confident offer introduction. No text, prices, logos, or watermark.

cards.label: Talking-Head Offer: creator shows jacket
cards.prompt: Photorealistic square fashion ad still: an adult creator wears a plain navy jacket and raises one cuff toward the camera, with the fit and fabric visible in a mirror. Warm indoor daylight, chest-up composition. Freeze a try-on review moment. No text, logos, or watermark.

cards.label: Jewelry Haul: earrings from gift box
cards.prompt: Photorealistic square gift ad still: hands lift plain gold hoop earrings from a small open gift box lined with tissue. Warm window light, close overhead composition with the pair centered. Freeze the reveal moment. No text, logos, or watermark.

cards.label: Try-On Offer: sneakers for weekend
cards.prompt: Photorealistic square sportswear ad still: an adult runner wears plain charcoal running sneakers with muted orange trim on a city sidewalk, both shoes fully visible. Natural morning light, low close framing. Freeze a planted step. No text, logos, or watermark.

cards.label: Product Demo: over-ear headphones fold
cards.prompt: Photorealistic square tech-demo ad still: an adult creator folds one ear cup of plain over-ear headphones inward, with the full headband and hinge visible. Soft desk light, close natural framing. Freeze the fold demonstration. No text, logos, or watermark.

cards.label: Gift Unboxing: resistance bands from box
cards.prompt: Photorealistic square fitness gift ad still: hands lift muted resistance bands from a plain open gift box, with the full set centered above tissue paper. Warm window light, close overhead composition. No text, logos, or watermark.

cards.label: First-Bite Reaction: protein bar offer
cards.prompt: Photorealistic square UGC ad still: an adult athlete holds a protein bar after one bite and smiles toward the camera, with the bite and wrapper both visible. Bright gym lounge daylight, chest-up framing. Freeze the first-bite reaction. No text, logos, or watermark.

cards.label: Problem-to-Solution: lint tool clears pet hair
cards.prompt: Photorealistic square pet-cleaning ad still: an adult owner presses a reusable lint tool to a pet-hair-covered sofa cushion, with the cleared strip visible beside the tool and a calm dog nearby. Natural living-room daylight, close framing. No text, logos, or watermark.
